context_requirements: Cells must express PFK-1 (PFKL/PFKM/PFKP) and depend on glycolysis for ATP and biosynthetic precursors.
Cells with high glycolytic flux and limited metabolic plasticity (e.g., PKM2-dominant, HIF-driven) are more sensitive.
Functional TP53 or intact stress/apoptotic signaling may be needed for the full transcriptional response.
Glucose availability in the medium is required for the drug to engage the glycolytic pathway.
falsifiers: No change in glycolysis-related or ATF4/ISR target genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
A consistent increase in MYC or cell-cycle gene expression rather than the predicted decrease.
No difference in response between glycolytic and non-glycolytic lines.
Predominant induction of generic stress genes without any metabolic or ISR signature.
